canonical_source.note: Same URL pattern for 2024/2025. Leaderboard (qualified) tables only — not full rosters. BIS mixes variant kanji (Itoh's name uses U+FA45 in 2025-26); normalize NFKC before matching. 2024 pages parse with a one-row header offset (positional columns).

data_status: VERIFIED — pulled live 2026-11-01 ~22:05 PT from NPB official BIS; cross-checked vs AP wire reports

players.fig23_angle: THE THESIS TEST: Triple Crown power, but a 26.7% K rate in a contact league — the deck's whole thesis says contact travels and whiff risk doesn't. Sato is the exception a GM must price, not a fit to assume.
players.name: Teruaki Sato
players.note: 2025 Central League MVP; 2026 Triple Crown (9th in NPB history, first since Murakami 2022); linked to Mets/Yankees/Dodgers/Phillies (Heyman, via NY Post)

players.fig23_angle: NPB-best 1.36 ERA in his FIRST year as a starter, one season removed from 31 saves. Availability/role question is the price question: 146 IP is his career high by ~90 innings.
players.name: Kaima Taira
players.note: 2020 PL Rookie of the Year; NPB record 39 consecutive scoreless appearances (2021); Passan (Sep 2026): 'might be the best starting pitcher available this winter outside of Tarik Skubal'
players.role: RHP — closer converted to starter in 2026

players.fig23_angle: THE THESIS FIT: elite walk suppression (4.7% BB in 2026, 3.6% in 2025) + workhorse innings (172-197 IP three straight years) = exactly the low-walk, available arm the cap model wants. The cautionary comp is in the same market: Tatsuya Imai got 3yr/$54M from Houston last winter, then a 4.93 ERA and a bullpen demotion (MLBTR).
players.name: Hiromi Itoh
players.note: 2025 Sawamura Award (NPB's Cy Young); 2021 Olympic gold; leads all qualified NPB starters in strikeouts over the past six seasons (902, per MLBTR)

posting_facts.also_posted_same_day: Si-Hwan Roh (Hanwha Eagles, KBO) — 30-day window, not NPB; context only
posting_facts.lockout_interaction: CBA expires Dec 1, 2026; posting clock pauses during a lockout (per MLBTR/AP)
posting_facts.posting_fee: 20% of first $25M of MLB contract, 17.5% of next $25M, 15% above $50M, plus 15% on bonuses/options actually earned/vested

title: The Posted Class — Japan's Window
verification_notes: Sato 2026 BIS line (.306/39 HR/106 RBI/.609 SLG/.383 OBP, 143 G) matches AP, Sportsnet, Yardbarker. NBC Sports carried .308/.385/.613 in 142 G — wire rounding/reporting difference; BIS official is canonical, use BIS.
Taira 2026 BIS line (1.36 ERA, 12-5, 146.0 IP, 141 K, 45 BB) matches Sportsnet/AP exactly. NBC's 141/46 K/BB differs by one walk; use BIS 45.
Itoh 2026 BIS: 3.18 ERA, 172.2 IP, 159 K match MLBTR; BIS counts 34 BB vs MLBTR's 32 — BIS canonical. Itoh K% 21.8% and BB% 4.7% computed from BIS BF (731) match MLBTR's stated rates.
Taira 2024 does not appear on BIS qualified leaderboards (reliever workload); his career line is on his BIS player page — pull in the build cycle if a 2024 row is needed. Do not backfill from memory.
